name: Child of Fortune
desc: You seem to have been favored by heaven and earth since birth; opportunities others seek in vain always find their way to you.
story_prompt: If the character has the "Child of Fortune" goldfinger, make "heaven's favor, opportunities that come of their own accord, and riding the momentum" an important thread in the story.

name: Deeply Blessed
desc: You are deeply blessed: in danger you often find a turning point, and in ordinary places you find unexpected gains.
story_prompt: If the character has the "Deeply Blessed" goldfinger, make "turning misfortune into luck, finding blessings in small things, and stumbling onto good fortune" an important thread in the story.

name: Transmigrator
desc: You come from another world, and your modern memories and way of thinking still shape how you see the cultivation world.
story_prompt: If the character has the "Transmigrator" goldfinger, focus on their modern mindset, their sense of being out of place in another world, and their attempts to understand or solve cultivation problems with modern experience.

name: Reincarnator
desc: You seem to have returned carrying traces of a past life, with an inexplicably sharp intuition for certain choices and dangers.
story_prompt: If the character has the "Reincarnator" goldfinger, focus on the lingering memories of their past life, their urge to avoid known pitfalls, their old obsessions, and their misjudgments about the future.

name: Old Grandpa in the Ring
desc: An unseen senior seems to be hidden in your fate, guiding you, urging you on, and even arguing with you at critical moments.
story_prompt: If the character has the "Old Grandpa in the Ring" goldfinger, focus on the hidden senior's guidance, arguments, secrets, and arrangements, giving the story a clear sense of companionship.
